set.body: Outcome: integrate complete source checkpoint9d8fe71 into main while preserving newer shared working files. Scope: Git source tree integration, additive checkpoint files, integration report. No scientific algorithm changes, no publication, no staging active provider extensions. Invariants: preserve all pre-existing working bytes and index changes; retain main-only history/evidence; checkpoint numerical source hashes unchanged. Proposed: compare complete trees, build isolated merge candidate with main preferred for already tracked differences and checkpoint baseline for missing source; verify locked Cargo path using existing artifacts; merge with explicit checkpoint ancestry and leave newer live changes unstaged. Acceptance: source completeness, exact numerical hash parity, clean candidate tests/format checks and working-tree preservation manifest. Disk1.5GiB: no full build or new target cache. Next: inspect differing paths and coordinate with provider owner.
set.title: Integrate qualified source checkpoint into main
